# NanoScrape

> NanoScrape (Apify namespace: santamaria-automations) publishes 196 web scraping actors on the Apify marketplace. Most are lightweight HTTP-only Go programs; sources with JS-only content or strict anti-bot walls run on browser-tier variants (and move them to HTTP-only Go when the source allows it). Categories: job boards (106), web tools & utilities (24), business directories (14), e-commerce (13), enrichment (11), marketplaces (9), social media (8), real estate (6), search & news (3), reviews (2). Every actor is billed pay-per-result on Apify (no monthly fee). Based in Switzerland.

## Key facts
- Runtime: Apify cloud; mostly HTTP-only Go actors (datacenter proxy default), browser-tier where the source requires it
- Pricing: pay-per-result, no monthly fee; Apify free tier $5/month
- Actor namespace on Apify: `santamaria-automations`
- Website: https://www.nanoscrape.com/
- Actor catalog (structured JSON): https://www.nanoscrape.com/search-index.json
- Sitemap index: https://www.nanoscrape.com/sitemap.xml
